errors.evidence: Each group on the x-axis contains seven bars, not six. There is one bar for the baseline model (Mistralv0.2-Base) and six bars for the fine-tuned models.

errors.text_span: with the shortest bar in the Cardio group reaching approximately -26.5
errors.evidence: The bar in the Cardio group reaching approximately -26.5 is the longest bar in that group, not the shortest. The bars are oriented downwards, so a more negative value corresponds to a longer bar.

errors.text_span: and the tallest bars across groups being around -22.5
errors.evidence: The bars are oriented downwards from a baseline of -22. A bar reaching -22.5 would be one of the shortest bars, not the tallest. The description incorrectly uses the term 'tallest'.
